subject: Next steps: DPA pathway proposal & SCC flavor choice
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@meridianpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps: DPA pathway proposal & SCC flavor choice

Hi Olivia — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Call recap
- Use case: payment authorization and basic fraud signals; transaction payload includes card metadata and customer email (PII).
- Regulated needs: GDPR applies (EU customers), HIPAA not in scope for payment flows.
- Compliance posture: MeridianPay will confirm controller/processor split; Redwood is proposing processor role for inference and tokenization.

Immediate asks / proposed routing
1) Controller/Processor: please confirm if MeridianPay will be the controller for transaction data and any customer-identifying fields (email, name). If yes, we'll proceed with DPA + SCC where Redwood is the processor.
2) SCC flavor: we ran through two approaches on the call — a standard SCC route (full module) vs modular SCC selections. My recommendation: sign the DPA and adopt SCC Module 2 (international transfers) plus Module 3 (data subject rights addendum) to explicitly cover cross-border subject access workflows. I've attached a short matrix (SCC_module_matrix.xlsx) with our recommendation ticked.
3) Evidence: MeridianPay requested SOC 2 evidence — attaching Redwood_SOC2-Report-2025.pdf (summary; full report available under NDA).
4) Vendor questionnaire: to speed procurement/legal review, please complete the attached Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.docx. If you prefer, we can send a smaller prefill for the controls you care about.

Attachments I've included: DPA_proposal_v1.pdf (editable), SCC_module_matrix.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2-Report-2025.pdf, and a quick vendor questionnaire template.

Timing / next steps
- Could you confirm controller status by EOD 12/08?
- If controller=MeridianPay, we'll: (a) finalize DPA draft and route to DocuSign, (b) lock SCC Module 2 + Module 3 and provide a marked copy for your counsel, (c) request that MeridianPay return the vendor questionnaire within five business days so legal can triage.

Open questions for you
- Do you require HSM/KMS architecture details for key management?
- Any additional regulatory peers to loop in (privacy counsel/contact)?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally and prepare the DocuSign flow once we have your controller confirmation.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: DPA_proposal_v1.pdf, SCC_module_matrix.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2-Report-2025.pdf, Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.docx]

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@meridianpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: MeridianPay Legal <legal@meridianpay.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: DPA pathway proposal & SCC flavor choice

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 

- Controller/Processor: MeridianPay will be the controller for transaction and customer-identifying data; Redwood will be the processor for the inference/tokenization workload.
- SCC preference: our legal team prefers a minimal surface area approach. We would like Redwood to sign Module 2 (international transfers) only at first. We are open to Module 3 but want to scope it narrowly — can you explain what Module 3 adds versus Module 2 in practice?
- SOC 2: please send the SOC 2 Type II report (we received the summary) — legal needs the full Type II report under NDA.
- Vendor questionnaire: we'll start the questionnaire on our side, but if you can provide a prefilled version for the controls related to data residency and encryption that would speed things up.

I attached a short MeridianPay security summary in case it's helpful: Mpay_Product_Security_Summary.pdf.

We aim to have an initial legal read by 12/18 — if your team can get the DocuSign DPA + marked SCC back to us by 12/14 that would help.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Payments Ops
MeridianPay

[Attachment: Mpay_Product_Security_Summary.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@meridianpay.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T11:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: DPA pathway proposal & SCC flavor choice

Hi Olivia — appreciate the quick turnaround and clarity on controller status. A few clarifications and a proposed plan from Redwood Privacy/Legal: 

1) Module rationale: Module 2 addresses standard international transfer clauses (adequacy + SCC cross-border safeguards). Module 3 (our suggested addendum) specifically captures operational commitments around data subject requests (timing, joint coordination, redaction rules). Practically: Module 3 is lightweight but gives both parties clear SLAs for responding to SARs and for redaction/pseudonymization responsibilities. If MeridianPay prefers to start with Module 2 only, we can do that and keep Module 3 as an optional addendum to be executed within 60 days of go-live.

2) SOC2: we can share the full 2025 Type II under NDA. I'll trigger the secure share after we get a signed mutual NDA or DocuSign DPA that includes the confidentiality clause.

3) KMS/HSM: we do use customer-segregated KMS keys for production tenant encryption; I can prepare an HSM/KMS architecture note for your infra team if you confirm that level of detail is required.

4) Scope suggestion (to reduce review friction): limit logged PII retained for 30 days and pseudonymize transaction IDs in analytics exports. If MeridianPay agrees, we'll reflect that in the DPA and the SCC matrix. 

Actionable items we will take after your confirmation: 
- Prepare a marked DPA (DPA_proposal_v1.pdf -> DPA_proposal_v1_marked.pdf) with Module 2 included and Module 3 flagged as optional addendum.
- Send DocuSign envelope for execution with a target signature date of 12/14.
- Prefill the vendor questionnaire for the controls you highlighted (data residency and encryption) and return it to you the same day.

Please confirm: (a) accept Module 2 with Module 3 optional, and (b) whether you want the HSM/KMS note. Once confirmed we’ll route the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference

[Attachments to be sent: Redwood_SOC2-Report-2025.pdf, prefilled Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.docx, DPA_proposal_v1_marked.pdf, SCC_module_matrix.xlsx]
